workflow: Launch the same prebuilt app on each simulator, enter distinct Unicode text, assert the resulting semantic UI, and capture a screenshot.
memory_method: Sum proc_pid_rusage physical footprint for every process in each simulator process tree. This is not unique system memory.
timing_note: The current concurrent Unicode workflow passed on both devices. A later clean timing rerun was blocked when the system disk filled while saving session state, so parallel_workflow_seconds retains the prior measured timing.
